title: wrench set over spec refused
why: A clear, well lit, entirely legitimate photograph of the WRONG SETTING. The case where good evidence must still fail — and where the failure is visible before the bolt is ever pulled.

step.title: Fit the new pads and torque the caliper bolts
step.explanation: An under-torqued caliper bolt backs out under braking heat and the caliper moves. This is the step that kills someone if it is skipped.

field.prompt: Photograph the wrench barrel showing what you set it to, then torque both caliper bolts to the click
field.acceptance_description: the barrel of a click-type torque wrench set to a value inside 27-33 Nm, read on the wrench's Nm scale, with the number and the scale both legible
field.guidance: Square on to the barrel so the number and the scale it sits on are both legible. This records what the tool was SET to. It is not a measurement of the bolt and the record files it as asserted.
